# Power of One - Personal Training Bangkok

## About
Power of One is a personal training service in Bangkok, Thailand, specializing in helping adults 40+ move better, get stronger, and live pain-free. Founded by Ramin Razy, a certified Functional Aging Specialist with 18+ years of experience.

## Key Information
- **Business Name**: Power of One - Personal Training Bangkok
- **Founder & Head Trainer**: Ramin Razy
- **Specialization**: Functional training for adults 40+, strength training, mobility, injury prevention
- **Location**: Bangkok, Thailand (Asoke, Phrom Phong area)
- **Services**: In-person training, online coaching, movement screening
- **Experience**: 18+ years in fitness industry
- **Contact**: +66 876 905 325 | raminpof1@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://personaltrainingbangkokp1.com

## Credentials
- Certified Functional Aging Specialist
- Bachelor of Education (Swinburne University of Technology)
- Former Royal Australian Navy
- Professional training in: Personal Training, Nutrition, Yoga, Pilates

## Services Offered

### 1. Free Movement and Strength Screening
Comprehensive assessment to identify current strength, mobility, and balance levels to determine the right starting point for training.

### 2. In-Person Personal Training
Safe, personalized coaching designed around individual goals, abilities, and experience. Training can be conducted at:
- Elite Fight Club gym (Phrom Phong)
- Client's condo gym (Asoke, Sukhumvit area)
- Terminal 21 area
- Exchange Tower area

### 3. Live Online Coaching
Real-time training sessions from anywhere with:
- Live instruction and technique correction
- Ongoing support and programming
- Suitable for clients globally

### 4. Functional Aging Training
Specialized programs for adults 40+ focusing on:
- Mobility and balance
- Strength building
- Injury prevention
- Maintaining independence
- Pain management

## Training Philosophy
- **Safe**: Every program begins with understanding goals, abilities, and starting point
- **Personalized**: Adapted to different learning styles and individual needs
- **Progressive**: Gradual advancement based on client progress
- **Holistic**: Focus on movement confidence, everyday strength, and long-term sustainability

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: How much does personal training cost in Bangkok?
A: Prices range from ฿1,500 to ฿3,000 per session. Power of One offers tailored packages with better value. Free consultation available to discuss pricing.

### Q: Do I need a gym to get strong?
A: No. You can build incredible strength using bodyweight exercises. However, Elite Fight Club gym access and condo gym training are available options.

### Q: Can I train with an injury?
A: Yes, with proper modifications. Programs are designed to work around injuries while maintaining progress safely.

### Q: Is training effective online?
A: Yes. Online training provides real-time instruction, technique correction, and customized programming. Many clients train successfully online from around the world.

### Q: What makes Power of One different?
A: 18+ years of experience, education background for clear communication, Functional Aging Specialist certification, personalized approach, and focus on sustainable, safe results.
